campaign.locked: Win the level before this one to open it.
menu.artAlt: A tiny tribe village on a round island diorama
howto.goal.head: The goal
howto.goal.text: Your tribe lives on a small round world. Destroy every rival Hearth, or meet the match goal shown at the top right, while your own Hearth stands. Water kills: anyone on land that sinks into the sea drowns.
howto.grow.head: Grow the village
howto.grow.text: Settlers gather wood and stone on their own. Press D to place Dwellings near your Hearth; full Dwellings breed new followers. More followers open new buildings: the Watchtower and the Warden Lodge at 10.
howto.spells.head: Mana and spells
howto.spells.text: Followers pray for mana. The slider at the top left splits them between Spells and Training. Pick a spell in the top bar (or Z, X, C, V, B, N) and click a target for your Shaper. Right click a spell to auto-charge it; Backspace takes back a cast.
howto.army.head: Your army
howto.army.text: Click a lodge to train Wardens (melee), Firecallers (ranged), Chanters (convert rivals) or Shades (disguise and sabotage). Drag a box to select, right click to move, A then click to attack-move, R to retreat, G to garrison a Watchtower.
howto.camera.head: Camera and keys
howto.camera.text: Wheel to zoom, Q and E to rotate, M for the whole world, click the minimap to jump there. P or Esc pauses, F is photo mode, H shows every key in play. Keys can be changed in Settings.
howto.start.head: Where to start
howto.start.text: Play the Campaign first: each level teaches one idea. In Skirmish, start with one easy rival. Keep your Shaper safe, and remember the land is a weapon: Raise Land builds ground, Erode and Quake sink it under your enemies.
menu.tagline: Shape the land. Lead your tribe. Keep them out of the sea.
pause.title: Paused
settings.tipsHint: Step by step tips in your next skirmish; they turn off once you finish them
setup.forgeHint: Reshape the land near your Hearth first.
setup.leyHint: Stones to capture by prayer: mana, a striking ward or far sight for whoever holds them.
setup.wolvesHint: Wolf dens in the wild: packs bite anyone who comes close. Clear a den with warriors.
setup.weatherHint: Rain slows every unit on the map.
setup.traitHint: A small bonus. Rivals then carry theirs too.
together.help: Both computers open the game from the host computer, served with npm run serve -- --lan. One hosts and reads out the room code; the other types it and joins.
together.waiting: Waiting for your partner to join...
together.hostNote: The match uses your Skirmish setup. Against each other: your partner plays the first rival tribe and any other tribes keep their AI. Together: you two are one team against every AI rival in the setup.
together.joined: Joined room {code}. Waiting for the host to start the match.
together.noPause: A LAN match keeps running while this menu is open.
together.resyncing: Back in the room. Loading the host's game...
together.awayWait: Your partner dropped out. Waiting {s} s for them to come back.
together.giveUp: Let the AI play their tribe
together.waitingPartner: Waiting for your partner's game to catch up...
